svg.title: Generate Plan Sequence — End-to-End ATO Optimization Chain
svg.desc: A sequence diagram generated by Archify.

g.desc: Use arrow keys to explore relationships. Press Enter or Space to pin details; Escape clears.

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 1 of 10: Commander to Tactical Web COP, set commander intent weights. Press Enter for details.
g.title: Commander → Tactical Web COP · set commander intent weights

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 2 of 10: Tactical Web COP to Fastify Gateway, POST /api/optimizer/solve. Press Enter for details.
g.title: Tactical Web COP → Fastify Gateway · POST /api/optimizer/solve

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 3 of 10: Fastify Gateway to ALNS Solver, dispatch tasking instance. Press Enter for details.
g.title: Fastify Gateway → ALNS Solver · dispatch tasking instance

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 4 of 10: ALNS Solver to HiGHS Sub-MIP, solve sub-neighborhood MIP. Press Enter for details.
g.title: ALNS Solver → HiGHS Sub-MIP · solve sub-neighborhood MIP

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 5 of 10: HiGHS Sub-MIP to ALNS Solver, return optimal sub-allocation. Press Enter for details.
g.title: HiGHS Sub-MIP → ALNS Solver · return optimal sub-allocation

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 6 of 10: ALNS Solver to Rule Verifier, verify 12 physical constraints. Press Enter for details.
g.title: ALNS Solver → Rule Verifier · verify 12 physical constraints

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 7 of 10: Rule Verifier to ALNS Solver, 0 hard violations confirmed. Press Enter for details.
g.title: Rule Verifier → ALNS Solver · 0 hard violations confirmed

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 8 of 10: ALNS Solver to Fastify Gateway, return 3 Pareto COA plans. Press Enter for details.
g.title: ALNS Solver → Fastify Gateway · return 3 Pareto COA plans

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 9 of 10: Fastify Gateway to Tactical Web COP, 200 OK + metrics + diffs. Press Enter for details.
g.title: Fastify Gateway → Tactical Web COP · 200 OK + metrics + diffs

g.aria-label: Inspect relationship 10 of 10: Tactical Web COP to Commander, render COA cards & ATO grid. Press Enter for details.
g.title: Tactical Web COP → Commander · render COA cards & ATO grid
